_about: Portable copy of the measured two-GPU expert-helper preset. Replace every <...> placeholder with your own path or device order; no placeholder is a working default. Start it with: python -m serve.server --engine strata --config <this-file> --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080

gpu_mapping.physical_gpu_1: fast card, PCIe 4 x16: layers, attention and native vision; first CUDA-visible device (CUDA0)
gpu_mapping.physical_gpu_0: slower PCIe card: 24 GB expert helper, second CUDA-visible device (CUDA1); not part of --gpus
gpu_mapping.cuda_visible_devices: The string below puts the fast physical GPU 1 first. Verify that order on your machine (for example with nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,pci.bus_id,link.gen,link.width) before starting; if your fast card has another index, change the order.
gpu_mapping.layer_device: --gpus 0 selects the first CUDA-visible device (the fast card). --tp 1 means one layer device, intentionally not a tensor-parallel pair.
gpu_mapping.helper_device: DS4_HELPER=1 selects the second CUDA-visible device (the slow card). The helper is not one of --gpus.

_checks: The pool is DS4_HELPER_GB=24 GB and the host warm cap is DS4_WARM_CAP_GB=98 GB; both are required together.
The measured run cloned its pack and profile into a private run directory; the profile seed SHA-256 is in results.json.
DSpark and suffix drafting are off; all six routed experts stay enabled and the quantization is unchanged.
Keep --parallel 1 for this preset: it is the measured setting.
